messages:
Devin: Seeing an alert spike — NATGateway nat-agg-prod-1 trending to port exhaustion across us-west-2a/us-west-2b. Application errors are Connection reset / ECONNRESET for outbound model pulls.
Devin: CloudWatch SNATPortUtilization ~ 0.98 on two NATs, packet drops and a bunch of short-lived flows.
Marta: Ugh. Did anything change at deploy time? image-puller rollout yesterday?
Devin: We rolled new prefetcher that parallelizes model shard downloads (concurrency x20). Probably a thundering herd.
Kai: That explains it. Lots of ephemeral sockets from same source IP -> NAT ports exhausted. Short TCP lifetimes + no keepalive.
Lee: Quick check: can we route heavy pulling subnets to additional NAT gateways? Add a NAT per AZ and rebalance route tables?
Marta: We already have per-AZ private subnets but only one nat-agg-prod-1 handles most egress. Route table associations might be uneven.
Devin: Logs show repeated resets: ```connect() failed: ECONNRESET (104) at 10.0.45.12: random high ports -> external:443```\nAlso lots of TIME_WAIT accumulation on nodes.
Kai: Short-term mitigations: 1) reduce prefetch concurrency, 2) re-enable HTTP keep-alive/connection pooling in the prefetcher, 3) add >1 NAT gateway in the hot AZs.
Lee: I'll spin up two extra NAT gateways (us-west-2a, 2b) and patch route associations to round-robin across them. ETA 20m.
Marta: I'll open a hotfix to throttle prefetcher concurrency to 4 and add exponential backoff on failures.
Devin: Also let's enable an internal egress proxy (squid/nginx) on the nodes or a fleet-level proxy so connections are reused — medium-term.
Kai: Monitoring: add per-node ephemeral-port-usage metric and NAT SNAT port utilization alarm at 70% instead of 90.
sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-382 - NAT port saturation. Assigned: Lee, Marta. Priority: high.
Lee: Done: created NAT nat-agg-prod-2/3, updated route tables for two subnets to use nat-agg-prod-2. Watch CloudWatch.
Devin: After mitigation we're seeing error rate drop ~85% and SNAT utilization stable at 0.4 — good.
Marta: Next steps (owner tags): Marta -> prefetch throttling PR; Kai -> proxy design and perf tests; Devin -> add metrics + dashboards; Lee -> document NAT capacity playbook.
Kai: Long-term: move model shard distribution to internal cache (S3 + VPC endpoint) + adopt connection pooling library for fetchers.
Devin: Thx all. Postmortem so we can tune autoscale and default prefetch limits.
Marta: :thumbsup:
